_about: The v4 entries for the two deployment lists, with <<V4:KEY>> placeholders that public-demo/v4/apply-v4-entries.py fills from the bring-up's v4.env (V4-PLAN step C1). Never copy this file into a list by hand: the apply script refuses a missing, malformed or leftover value, and web/deposit/test/deployments.test.mjs refuses any '<<V4:' in a build.

module.name: bridge-test-network-v4
module.label: Sepolia vault v4 (proof-checked) → bridge test network (LEZ 0.4)
notes: Sepolia is an Ethereum test network: its coins have no value. Deposits are claimed on the bridge test network (LEZ 0.4), the team's own chain.
Withdrawals back to Ethereum are checked by proof on Ethereum. The first proofs are being set up; until then a burn waits.
Which bridge test network blocks count is the bridge operator's word until a finality proof for that chain exists; the vault's caps and a one-hour delay bound a wrong update.
The bridge's relay pays a public claim's fee: the account needs no LEZ.
v4 vault: RISC Zero's Groth16 verifier 3.1.0 checks every update and release proof (gate <<V4:GATE>>; updates only from its submitter); deposit desk at 30 bps.
